text.tspan: Fertility rate among women aged 45 to 49

The
age-specific fertility rate
for women aged 45 to 49, measured as the number of live births per 1,000 women

in this age group. Future projections are based on the
UN's low scenario
.
Data source: UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
